title: Multi-Sequence Alignment and Phylogenetics
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ziwf4fe

steps.title: Download and Prepare Tutorial Data
steps.instruction: Clone the tutorial repository and verify the presence of the SSU rRNA gene sequences.

substeps.instruction: List files to confirm `SSU_seqs.fna` is present: `ls -lh`

steps.title: Inspect Sequence Data
steps.instruction: Review the FASTA sequences to check length and GC content.

substeps.instruction: View the start of the file: `head SSU_seqs.fna`
Use seqkit to check sequence lengths and GC content: `seqkit fx2tab -l -g -n SSU_seqs.fna`

steps.title: Perform Multi-Sequence Alignment
steps.instruction: Use Clustal Omega to perform a global alignment of the SSU sequences.

substeps.instruction: Check that all sequences are now the same length: `seqkit fx2tab -l -n -g SSU.aln`

steps.title: Export Alignment in Alternative Formats
steps.instruction: Generate the alignment in Phylip and Clustal formats for compatibility with other tools.

substeps.instruction: Export to Phylip format: `clustalo -i SSU_seqs.fna -o SSU.phy.aln --outfmt=phy`
Export to Clustal format: `clustalo -i SSU_seqs.fna -o SSU.clu.aln --outfmt=clu`

steps.title: Infer Phylogenetic Tree
steps.instruction: Use FastTree to generate a phylogenetic tree in Newick format from the alignment.

substeps.instruction: Verify the Newick file: `ls -la` and `head SSU.nwk`

steps.title: Visualize Tree with iTOL
steps.instruction: Upload the Newick file to the interactive Tree of Life (iTOL) web tool for visualization and analysis.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to `itol.embl.de` and upload the `.nwk` file or paste the text into the upload tab.
Adjust branch line width in the 'basic' menu.
In the 'advanced' menu, display 'bootstraps/metadata' as text to view node support values (0 to 1).
Root the tree by selecting the branch above Nitrososphaera and Sulfolobus, then select 'Tree Structure' -> 'Reroot tree here'.

steps.title: Extract 16S Gene from New Genome
steps.instruction: Download a target genome and isolate the 16S rRNA sequence.

substeps.instruction: Download the Rickettsia prowazekii genome: `wget -O rickettsia.fna.gz ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/195/735/GCF_000195735.1_ASM19573v1/GCF_000195735.1_ASM19573v1_genomic.fna.gz`
Extract the FASTA sequence using BedTools: `bedtools getfasta -s -fi rickettsia.fna -bed rick.16S.gff -fo rick.16S.fna`

steps.title: Integrate New Sequence into Phylogeny
steps.instruction: Combine the new sequence with existing references and repeat the alignment and tree inference process.

substeps.instruction: Visualize the resulting tree in iTOL.
